name: Glue stick
summary: Twisting the knob at the bottom raises a stick of glue out of the tube, and a cap pushes on to keep it from drying.

parts.name: Tube
parts.role: The plastic tube that holds the stick of glue.

parts.name: Bottom knob
parts.role: The ridged wheel you twist to raise or lower the glue.

parts.name: Glue stick
parts.role: The solid stick of glue that rises out of the top.

parts.name: Cap
parts.role: Pushes on over the top with a click.
